lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately six vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical zones of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the centroids of the high-luminance blobs, forming a coordinate-like grid across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a light-above-dark shadow gradient, extending from the posterior head towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: An irregular distribution of approximately 8-12 low-resolution high-luminance blobs visible within the boundaries of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) attached ventrally to the pectoral fin base; artificial blue circular overlay with the text 'Dive' in the upper right frame.
